TING.gloss: a light clear metallic sound as of a small bell
TING.definition: A light clear metallic sound as of a small bell.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

TIE.gloss: neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn under a collar and tied in…
TIE.definition: Neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn (mostly by men) under a collar and tied in knot at the front.
TIE.example: He stood in front of the mirror tightening his necktie.

GEN.example: Give me the gen on your new line of computers.

GET.gloss: come into the possession of something concrete or abstract
GET.definition: Come into the possession of something concrete or abstract.
GET.example: She got a lot of paintings from her uncle.

TIN.gloss: a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion
TIN.definition: A silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide.

GIN.gloss: strong liquor flavored with juniper berries
GIN.definition: Strong liquor flavored with juniper berries.
